articles.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
articles.snippet: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

articles.title: Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ latest to object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks
articles.snippet: More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.

articles.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

articles.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
articles.snippet: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.

articles.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
articles.snippet: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.
